• Compact cordless hand-held compressor for use on-the-go – ideal for inflating car or bicycle tyres as well as toys and sporting equipment
• 5 modes to choose from: bicycle mode, motorbike mode, car mode, ball mode and manual mode
• Maximum 10.3 bar operating pressure
• LCD display shows the mode, current pressure, pressure unit as well as battery capacity
